ASL alphabet illustrations extracted without redrawing from Asl alphabet gallaudet.svg, Wikimedia Commons.
Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Asl_alphabet_gallaudet.svg
Author: Darren Stone (Ds13), vectorized by Marnanel. Derived from Gallaudet-TT font by David Rakowski (1991).
License: Public domain, released by Ds13. Commons description notes font distribution allows any use and free redistribution; original uploader expressed uncertainty about font-to-image licensing and requested corrections. Commons currently labels the chart public domain.
Changes: Extracted each existing letter group; removed letter text; cropped SVG viewBox to art plus 2 units padding. Original hand paths/colors and J/Z movement arrows retained.
